records.text: University Academic Safety Code: advanced laboratory sections may enroll no more than 18 students. Effective 2026-01-01. Current university safety code. Sets an 18-student cap for advanced laboratory sections university-wide. Level 1 university safety authority; overrides school-level scheduling rules where both apply to advanced laboratories.

School of Engineering Scheduling Manual: Engineering course sections may enroll up to 24 students unless a higher-level safety rule sets a lower cap for the section type. Effective 2026-03-01. Current school scheduling rule. Sets a general 24-student Engineering section cap subject to higher-level safety constraints. Level 2 school scheduling authority; subordinate to Level 1 university safety rules on overlapping scope.

School of Engineering seminar sections may enroll up to 28 students. Effective 2026-08-15. Current seminar-specific scheduling rule. Sets a cap for seminar sections, not advanced laboratory sections. Level 2 school scheduling authority for seminar sections only.

Advanced laboratory enrollment rosters must include each student's completed safety-orientation date. Effective 2026-09-01. Current laboratory roster rule. Adds a roster field requirement but does not set enrollment capacity. Authoritative education-administration rule for laboratory roster documentation only.
